lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white spots arranged in a quasi-grid. A prominent cluster of four large spots forms a trapezoidal arrangement dorsally to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectangular lattice where spots act as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow transition moving ventrally across each linear feature.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several white linear striations and scratches are visible on the lateral flank above the pectoral fin. The distal margin of the pectoral fin appears ragged with irregular notches.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light patterns from the water surface are projected onto the upper dorsal surface, creating a transient high-luminance mesh that overlays the natural pigmentation.
